patch_description: This redesign uses a cached, modular active-constraint optimization pipeline. It searches several deterministic “islands” in affine simplex coordinates, generates directed proposals from gradients of the currently smallest triangle determinants, mixes these with coupled stochastic repairs, and finishes with an optional SLSQP maximin polish. The result is validated against a safe fallback before conversion to Cartesian coordinates, keeping calls to the public constructor effectively constant-time after initialization.
